newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Apr-June industry output seen down 0.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan Apr-June industry output seen down 0.4 pct.

text.p: Japan's industrial output in the April-June quarter is expected to fall 0.4 percent from the previous quarter and rise 6.5 percent from the same period a year earlier, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Tuesday.
A MITI official said the ministry's forecast for manufacturers' output had been revised to a month-on-month rise of 0.3 percent in April from an original forecast of 1.9 percent growth.
For May, the forecast was left unchanged at a month-on-month increase of 1.1 percent.
The official said the ministry revises all its figures every year in March and accordingly the preliminary figures for March and the forecasts for April and May had also been revised.
He added, however, that there was no inherent change in the upward trend of industrial output. He added that the trend in capacity utilisation was quite firm.
